newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan PM, Peru president to meet on hostages--Jiji.
newsitem.headline: Japan PM, Peru president to meet on hostages--Jiji.

text.p: Prime Minister Ryutaro Hashimoto will meet Peruvian President Alberto Fujimori in Toronto on Friday over the hostage standoff at the Japanese ambassador's residence in Lima, Jiji news agency reported on Wednesday.
The prime minister's office had no immediate comment on the report from the Japanese news agency.

In the past two days, Hashimoto has urged Fujimori in telephone calls to be careful about stepping up pressure on the leftist Tupac Amaru Revolutionary Movement (MRTA) guerrillas holding 72 hostages at the residence.
Efforts to start talks with the guerrillas have stalled over the main rebel demand of freedom for about 400 jailed comrades, which Fujimori has refused to discuss.

The MRTA rebels fired several bullets on Monday at police aboard a convoy of armoured cars after officers made obscene gestures toward the residence while parading by. Even after the shooting, security forces, who had orders not to return fire, continued their manoeuvres in an apparent attempt to crack the resolve of the estimated 15 rebels.
